scope: Public historical/archival metadata and schemas; no private living-person dossiers

Ung.note: Ung is used as a romanization/transliteration in multiple Chinese-dialect and Southeast Asian contexts. A specific Chinese character, locality, or historical person is required before attributing a lineage.

Chinese_royal_families.note: For research purposes, this dataset treats imperial houses and historically documented royal/princely lineages as archival entities rather than treating modern descendants as a single group.

source_findings.jiapu: Public genealogy guidance describes jiapu/zupu as clan lineage books containing origins, migrations, pedigrees, biographies, ancestral halls, cemetery maps, family rules, teachings, and generation poems. FamilySearch reports a collection exceeding 65,000 Chinese jiapu records.
source_findings.qing_archives: Taiwan's government open-data catalog exposes National Palace Museum Qing archive metadata including unified number, document number, document type, author, originator/official position, formation date, form, size, and collection website.
source_findings.historical_text_analysis: Public research datasets demonstrate that historical Chinese texts can be modeled with named entities and relations across dynastic periods; such datasets are useful for schema design but do not establish genealogical descent by themselves.

validation_rules: Do not infer descent from surname alone
Require at least one cited historical record for each claimed relationship
Keep primary-source transcription separate from modern interpretation
Record alternate Chinese characters and romanizations separately
Distinguish dynasty membership from biological descent
Mark uncertain, disputed, legendary, and documentary claims separately
Do not convert historical association into claims about living people without specific public evidence
privacy_boundary: No genetic data from living individuals
No financial, medical, credential, or account data
provenance_note: This is a research schema and public-source inventory. It is not a complete genealogical database and does not assert that every person with a surname belongs to an imperial or royal lineage.
